fields.title: ConsulDent
fields.description: ConsulDent is a clinical AI assistant for dentists, live on the App Store. Every answer is grounded in retrievable clinical sources — books, guidelines, reference documents — instead of model intuition, and comes back as structured output that fits the actual workflow: visit preparation, treatment explanations, clinical notes, patient communication. Voice input handles the reality of a clinic, where typing mid-procedure isn't an option. Under the hood it is a backend-first system: RAG pipelines, agent-style reasoning flows, and structured outputs rather than a chat box.
fields.tech_stack: Python, RAG, LLM Integration, FastAPI, React
